QuestInfo.name: You Scratch My Back...
QuestInfo.0: Will Agent M be surprised to see you?
QuestInfo.1: Will Agent M be surprised to see you?
QuestInfo.2: Agent M offered you a trade.

0.0: You really don't take a hint! Fine, you caught me. I'm a secret agent. So, what do you want?\r\n#L0##bI wish to borrow your information network.#l\n#k
0.1: Ha, is that all? Why don't I just hand you all our secrets in a briefcase, while I'm at it?\r\n#L0##bIs there no way you will consider an alliance?#l\n#k
0.2: Well... All right. Maybe I could make you useful.

yes.0: You do some things for me, and we'll see what we can work out.

no.0: Changed your mind? Then leave me alone!
